propertyEvents.result: Job S-2607's estimate to complete was last revised September 22 and is unchanged, line for line, from September 30. Ridgecrest Veterinary Exam Room Expansion took $21,350.00 of cost in October, but every cost code's estimate to complete at October 31 equals its September 30 figure; the revision is dated September 22 with the note "Rolled forward". Carried as is, estimated total cost rises by exactly October's cost, from $190,000.00 to $211,350.00, and estimated gross profit fades $21,350.00. That is the mark of an estimate not revised, not a measured fade. Under WIP-4 the schedule recognizes no October revenue on this job until Sam Whitaker revises it: earned revenue stays at September's $133,402.11. On the carried estimate it would be $141,624.70, another $8,222.59.
